name: Online Character Sheets
body:
Character sheets made using Google Docs. The originals are locked, but anyone is free to make copies of them to use however they want.

These character sheets can be somewhat complicated, but are also fairly powerful. To use them, it is recommended that at least one person in your gaming group be comfortable with editing spreadsheets. In return for a little investment by one person, the whole group should hopefully enjoy faster play. The advanced features of these sheets should also help players who are not as familiar with the rules such that they don’t have to do as many calculations or keep track of as many factors.

In addition to the base template, included here are also several class templates and an alternative format. While it wouldn’t be feasible to have a template for every class, there should be enough examples here to get people started on creating their own character sheets for their unique character ideas.

Many thanks to those that have contributed with suggestions, comments, and especially whole new templates! Credit below to those that have provided their own sheets to share! More templates for new classes, color schemes, or layouts are always welcome!
